title: Ansel and the Confession
author: Oscar Joubert
blurb: Lior Halloran, an estate lawyer reading a will that shouldn't exist, prides themselves on never taking a case they can't close. But when a body turns up dressed in clothes stolen from the witness's own closet, they discover that staying invisible was never really an option. To get through this, they must untangle alibis woven thirty years ago before the anniversary dinner raises its glass.
style: vivid, cinematic prose with tight pacing
